It includes a stylized logo at the top left, followed by sections for 'Appetizers', 'Entrees', and 'Desserts'. The text is largely illegible gibberish, mimicking the appearance of a printed menu but failing to render coherent words or prices. There are faint horizontal lines separating sections.
